steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: After Salamis, Xerxes returned to Persia leaving Mardonius with an army to complete the conquest of Greece

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Mardonius tried to divide the Greeks by offering Athens favourable terms; Athens refused and the city was evacuated again

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: At Plataea (479 BC), the Greek army under the Spartan regent Pausanias defeated the Persians; Mardonius was killed

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Battle of Mycale (479 BC) was a simultaneous Greek naval victory that destroyed the remaining Persian fleet in Ionia

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Mardonius offered Athens generous peace terms, including rebuilding their temples, if they switched sides. The Athenians refused, replying that they would never betray Greece.
